purpose: Teach: 送別/追従/面識/外形/技巧/乗組/パネリスト/不買

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 退職する田中さんの送別会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare a farewell gathering for Tanaka, who's retiring.
lines.style: Brisk, organized opening. Professional but warm. Moving through the point with quiet authority. No ceremony, just work that needs doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同業他社への追従を避けます
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure not to poach anyone from competitors.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Clear agreement. Steady, cooperative tempo. Showing he's tracking her direction without needing elaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 面識のないお取引先にも丁寧に挨拶しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure to greet any business partners we haven't met before with real care.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Slightly slower, emphasizing the importance. Warm expectation — this matters. Measured, instructive pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の外形デザインを公開します
lines.en: Yes. I'll release the new product's exterior design to them.
lines.style: Practical confirmation. Slightly quicker than before — he's moving through the checklist. Focused, efficient delivery without coldness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 職人の技巧を映像に残しましょう
lines.en: Let's capture the craftspeople's skill and technique on video before they go.
lines.style: Softer here. This one carries weight — she's thinking about legacy. Slightly slower attack. Caring conviction underneath the direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。船舶事業の乗組員リストを更新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll update the crew roster for the maritime division.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. He's taking notes mentally. Reliable, unflashy confirmation. The pace of someone who's got it and will follow through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: シンポジウムのパネリストを推薦しましょう
lines.en: Let's recommend some panelists for the symposium.
lines.style: Forward momentum returning. Practical, planning-focused. Light energy on the opening. Moving to the next item with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品の不買運動はないか確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check whether there's any boycott activity against our products.
lines.style: Closing line — slightly more weight. Careful, thorough. Making sure nothing's been missed. Attentive, protective tone.
